Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation sprite sheet, NOT a character concept poster. Reference image is the canonical Veyra Codex. Use ONLY the three small PIXEL SPRITES on the RIGHT as identity and medium reference; ignore the large painted portrait and all typography. Create original missing gameplay poses for that exact character: petite chibi dark fantasy female assassin, large head, deep burgundy swept hair with thick long braid, pale skin, scar on forehead, dark brown leather and bronze buckles, crimson neck scarf and split waist cloth, one armored arm and opposite cream bandaged arm, TWO silver curved blood-edged short swords, one per hand. Preserve same design throughout. Clean native pixel clusters, crisp dark 1pixel outline, controlled stepped shading, no painterly smoothing. True transparent background.
LAYOUT: one 4-column by 7-row exact regular animation sheet, 28 separate full-body sprites, no labels or grid lines, equal square cells, enough transparent margins to enclose both swords and braid in EVERY cell. All characters face DOWN/front (slightly top-down game camera); identical body scale and feet baseline except fall. 4 sequential frames per row, meaningful motion, not repeated identical poses.
ROW1 idle: relaxed breathing four phases, both swords down. ROW2 walk: alternating left/right steps four phases. ROW3 attack: windup, two blade crossing strike, follow-through, recovery. ROW4 cast: crouched preparation, forward twin-blade gesture, release pose, recovery; no painted VFX. ROW5 ultimate: brace, arms spread with two blades, overhead crossed blades, return; no effects baked in. ROW6 hurt: impact recoil, torso flinch, recover, ready; retain both weapons. ROW7 death: knees buckle, kneel, fall to side, fully prone on ground. No detached limbs, no chopped swords, no new props or background. Exactly 28 sprites. Faithfully match reference silhouette, costume, hair and palette. Each cell has a single character.

right:
Production sprite sheet Veyra: TRUE RIGHT-FACING PROFILE. Use the small sprite labelled LADO in the supplied Codex reference as the ONLY pose and identity reference. The nose points to the RIGHT EDGE, one eye visible, shoulder/hips in profile, feet oriented right. Absolutely NO front-facing or three-quarter-facing portraits. All 28 figures must face RIGHT. Same burgundy braided hair, leather armor, bronze buckles, pale skin, bandaged arm, crimson cloth, TWO curved short swords. Pixel-art medium of the small sprites, not the painted portrait.
Exact 4 columns x7 rows, equal square cells on transparent background, generous blank margins (figure and weapons within inner70% of cell), no text. 4 animation phases per row, fixed scale and baseline. Row1 idle breathing, row2 walking right (genuine alternate footfalls), row3 attack windup-strike-followthrough-recover to right, row4 spellcast preparation-gesture-release-recover toward right, row5 ultimate brace-raise paired swords-cross-release, row6 hit recoil-flinch-recovery-ready, row7 death stagger-kneel-fall-prone right. Keep character design and side-on camera constant throughout. No shadows on background, no VFX, no grid lines. A complete side-on animation sheet, never front view.
up:
Production animation sprite sheet of VEYRA, exact character in supplied Codex. Use small BACK sprite labelled ESPALDA as identity/pose reference. Strict REAR VIEW on ALL28 figures: back of burgundy braided head, back of dark leather/bronze costume, crimson split cloth, cream bandaged arm vs armored arm, two curved silver-red short blades. NO faces or eyes visible. Slight overhead RPG camera, same chibi pixel character as reference, stepped pixel clusters/dark outline.
4 columns x7 rows of equal cells, exactly28 separate complete figures on transparent background, NO lettering/grid/background. Wide empty gutters. Figures and extended weapons occupy only CENTRAL65% of each cell, no contact between cells. Identical body scale. Seven four-frame clips, all viewed FROM BEHIND: row1 idle; row2 walk away from camera with alternate foot steps; row3 twinblade attack forward away from camera, windup/strike/followthrough/return; row4 cast preparation/gesture/release/recover; row5 ultimate brace/raise two blades/cross overhead/release; row6 hurt recoil/flinch/recover/ready; row7 death stagger/kneel/fall/prone. Keep braid, TWO weapons, costume and anatomy consistent. All silhouettes fully inside own cells, even prone. No effects baked in. This is a usable pixel sprite sheet, not a painting or concept poster.
left:
Production sprite sheet VEYRA facing LEFT. Use supplied Codex small pixel sprites as identity, NOT large painted illustration. Create the anatomically opposite LEFT profile; do not just mirror the right profile: retain her character-left arm's cream bandages and character-right dark shoulder armor. Nose points LEFT, one eye visible, back braid trails RIGHT, two curved silver short blades with blood-red edge. Burgundy braided hair, pale skin, forehead scar, dark leather/bronze buckles, crimson split cloth. Crisp stepped pixel art/chibi like the small reference sprites.
Exact4columns7rows=28 complete separate figures, all face LEFT. Equal cells with generous transparent gutters; single sprite in central65% of each cell, no cutoffs or intercell touching. Same body scale/pivot. 4 phases per row: 1 idle breathing;2 walk left alternating feet;3 attack left windup/strike/followthrough/recover;4 cast prepare/gesture/release/recover;5 ultimate brace/raise two swords/cross/release;6 hurt recoil/flinch/recover/ready;7 death stagger/kneel/fall/prone. Retain both swords every phase, no flying weapons, no effects/background/text/grid. Full body left-profile animation, NEVER front-facing. True transparent alpha.
